```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/00_utils/notebook_setup.R")
```

**Stage:** S7 (fit and compare).
**Purpose:** fit every predeclared model family per gauge and report held-out
metrics, then form the paired confirmatory contrast.
**Inputs:** `output/metrics_e1.csv`, `output/metrics_e2.csv`,
`output/paired_e1.csv`, `output/paired_e2.csv`.
**Outputs:** none.
**Parameters:** `P$L2`, `P$train_years`, `P$test_years`, `P$seed`.

## Per-family held-out metrics

```{r}
m1 <- nb_require("metrics_e1.csv", "S7")
m2 <- nb_require("metrics_e2.csv", "S7")
nb_assert_cols(m1, c("gauge_id", "family", "n_train", "n_test",
                     "brier", "auc", "logloss"), "E1 metrics")
nb_assert(setequal(unique(m1$family), names(FAMILY_FEATURES)),
          "not every family was fitted in E1")
nb_assert(setequal(unique(m2$family), names(FAMILY_FEATURES_E2)),
          "not every family was fitted in E2")

agg <- function(m, ep) {
  m[, .(endpoint = ep, mean_brier = mean(brier, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_auc = mean(auc, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_logloss = mean(logloss, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = family]
}
knitr::kable(rbind(agg(m1, "E1"), agg(m2, "E2")), digits = 4,
             caption = "Mean held-out metrics by family and endpoint")
```

## Paired confirmatory contrast

The confirmatory statistic scores SSI-3 and SSI-3 + queue on the **same**
held-out months. Per-family metrics above are descriptive and may use
family-specific complete-case samples; they are never used as `Delta_g`.

```{r}
pe1 <- nb_require("paired_e1.csv", "S7")
pe2 <- nb_require("paired_e2.csv", "S7")
nb_assert_cols(pe1, c("gauge_id", "n_months", "brier_a", "brier_b",
                      "delta_brier", "delta_auc"), "paired E1")
nb_assert(all(abs(pe1$delta_brier - (pe1$brier_a - pe1$brier_b)) < 1e-12),
          "delta_brier is not the paired Brier difference")

knitr::kable(data.table(
  endpoint = c("E1 concurrent", "E2 prospective"),
  n_gauges = c(nrow(pe1), nrow(pe2)),
  median_delta_brier = round(c(median(pe1$delta_brier, na.rm = TRUE),
                               median(pe2$delta_brier, na.rm = TRUE)), 6),
  median_delta_auc = round(c(median(pe1$delta_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
                             median(pe2$delta_auc, na.rm = TRUE)), 4),
  auc_improved = c(sum(pe1$delta_auc > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                   sum(pe2$delta_auc > 0, na.rm = TRUE))
), caption = "Paired primary contrast (positive = queue improves)")
```

`[measurement]` Positive `Delta_g` means the queue lowers the Brier score.
The interval and sign test that decide the endpoint are computed in the next
notebook from the same paired rows.
